About this item

  • 【Premium 50-Count Pack】 Each package contains 50 high-quality window gift card sleeves, meticulously designed to meet your daily, business, or festive event needs. These envelopes are perfectly sized to accommodate standard credit cards and various gift cards, offering convenience and versatility.
  • 【Clear View Window Design】 Featuring a distinctive transparent film window, these envelopes allow for a clear display of enclosed gift cards, membership cards, or cherished photos without removal, adding a touch of sophistication and professionalism. An ideal choice for conveying sentiments and enhancing presentation.
  • 【Quality Kraft Paper Material】 Crafted from durable and eco-friendly kraft paper, these gift card envelopes provide a pleasant tactile experience and a smooth surface for writing, resisting tears and wear. The classic kraft paper tone exudes a simple yet elegant charm, suitable for diverse occasions and reflecting refined taste.
  • 【Versatile & Widely Applicable】 Excellently suited for business invitation cards, party greeting invitation cards, holiday greeting cards, thank you notes, and more. Whether for corporate functions, weddings, birthday celebrations, Christmas, Thanksgiving, or as everyday small mailing envelopes, they serve as an ideal medium for your well wishes and messages.
  • 【Convenient & User-Friendly】 The gift card holder design ensures portability and ease of mailing. Neat edges, these envelopes are simple to seal securely, safeguarding their contents. A practical solution for individuals, small businesses, or event organizers seeking elegant gift card holders.

5 out of 5 stars
I love it! It works great and fits perfectly!
These gift card holders are great for any card and any person, kids or adults. I like that it is plain brown, so I can customize it by adding a sticker or writing on it. I can reuse to keep away from landfills. It is a good, strong material. I was able to use one for two gifts at different times, and it still doesn’t look like it been used. I love the little window; it helps me remember which card I have in it, and I don’t accidentally throw it away. The big pack is great to keep handy with so much family, it’s hard to keep up with all the birthdays and gifts. I love it! It works great and fits perfectly. This makes it easy to find last-minute gifts for any occasion!

    Cute easy way to present a gift card.
    Reviewed in the United States on October 19, 2025
    Color: Black
    Vine Customer Review of Free Product
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Easy and simple to use gift card envelopes. I liked that these had a cute little heart flap, so that if I didn’t have time to embellish them, they would be a fun touch. It’s great that these are plain black, allowing for easy and beautiful embellishments or decorations. The window on the front doesn’t hide the gift card making it really easy to see and not mistaken it for anything else. The paper feels sturdy and durable, not cheap.

    I only noticed one down side; I didn’t like that the gift card would slide around making it off center, not the worse thing but I feel like it makes it look weird. So I’d have to put a little tape to secure it from sliding.

    Still, I do think it’s a nice and simple to use for a gift card instead of just handing someone a gift card. It’s not too expensive and adds a nice touch.

    I only noticed one down side; I didn’t like that the gift card would slide around making it off center, not the worse thing but I feel like it makes it look weird. So I’d have to put a little tape to secure it from sliding.

    Still, I do think it’s a nice and simple to use for a gift card instead of just handing someone a gift card. It’s not too expensive and adds a nice touch.

    I ordered the 50 Pack Window Gift Card Envelopes in black and have been genuinely impressed.

    🫡 Look: The black kraft envelopes look classy and add a touch of sophistication to any gift or invitation. The heart-shaped clasp is a cute, charming detail that elevates the presentation without being over-the-top.

    🃏Appeal: Generous 50-count pack, great value for holidays, parties, and business gifts.

    💪🏼Durability: Durable kraft material with a sleek black finish that works for formal and casual occasions.

    🏆Design: Size is almost perfect for most standard gift cards (about 4 x 2.8 inches); the envelope feels snug without being difficult to slide cards in.

    Practical clasp design (heart shape) keeps cards secure while adding a lovely decorative touch.

    Versatile for gift cards, small invitations, or business thank-you notes.

    💳 Function: The closure is magnetic-free; you might want to add a light adhesive if you plan to ship or require extra security. A few envelopes can be a touch rigid when new; they loosen up after a bit of use.

    ⚖️ Final Verdict: If you’re looking for an elegant, budget-friendly way to present gift cards for holidays, parties, or client gifts, these black kraft envelopes are a winner. They look premium, protect the card, and come in a very useful bundle.
